# FieldSlate

FieldSlate is league operations software for volunteer-run youth sports leagues.
It schedules games and practices with field-conflict detection, assigns officials
(automatically or by officials' own sign-up), builds snack shack shifts from the
game schedule, and runs volunteer sign-ups with family goal tracking, all in one
connected system. When a game moves, officials' assignments and volunteers'
spots move with it, volunteers are emailed, and families' team calendar feeds
update on their own. FieldSlate pairs with registration platforms such as
PlayMetrics rather than replacing them; it does not take registrations or
payments. It is built for the volunteer admins who run Little League and other
rec leagues. It stores no player personal data, ever. When a league turns on
volunteer sign-ups, families enter a first initial, last name and email to take
a spot; nothing else.

FieldSlate builds schedules with rule-based logic from each league's own
settings; it does not use AI.

- Pricing: https://www.thefieldslate.com/#pricing
- Blog: https://www.thefieldslate.com/blog
- Volunteer sign-ups help (for families signing up through their league's link):
  https://www.thefieldslate.com/help/volunteers
- Officials sign-up help (for officials taking open games through their league's
  private link): https://www.thefieldslate.com/help/officials-signup
- Practice field calculator (free, no sign-in) — how many practice fields a
  league should request from its city, night by night, by field type
  (baseball and softball diamonds, soccer fields), with a sunset check. Runs
  in the browser; nothing entered is saved or sent:
  https://www.thefieldslate.com/tools/practice-field-calculator
- Sports Connect Alternatives in 2026 — what the PlayMetrics transition does and
  doesn't solve for Little League admins:
  https://www.thefieldslate.com/blog/sports-connect-alternatives-little-league
- Little League Scheduling Software: an honest guide for volunteer boards —
  what makes Little League scheduling hard and how to choose a tool:
  https://www.thefieldslate.com/blog/little-league-scheduling-software
- Keep Your League Software. Fix Your Schedule. — FieldSlate as a scheduling
  companion alongside a league's registration platform and website:
  https://www.thefieldslate.com/blog/league-scheduling-companion
- Why I Built FieldSlate — a Little League board member on why the tool exists:

- How Many Practice Fields Does Your League Need? — a guide for volunteer
